description: This file defines the ContentDefinitionManager class, which manages content type and part definitions within the OrchardCore CMS framework. It includes methods for loading, listing, deleting, and storing content definitions, utilizing caching and handling content definition records.

classes.name: ContentDefinitionManager
classes.description: Manages content type and part definitions, including loading, listing, deleting, and storing definitions with caching support.

methods.name: LoadTypeDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Loads all content type definitions asynchronously from the store.

methods.name: ListTypeDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Lists all content type definitions asynchronously.

methods.name: LoadPartDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Loads all content part definitions asynchronously.

methods.name: ListPartDefinitionsAsync
methods.description: Lists all content part definitions asynchronously.

methods.name: LoadTypeDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Loads a specific content type definition by name asynchronously.

methods.name: GetTypeDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content type definition by name asynchronously, with document validation.

methods.name: LoadPartDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Loads a specific content part definition by name asynchronously.

methods.name: GetPartDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific content part definition by name asynchronously, with document validation.

methods.name: DeleteTypeDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Deletes a content type definition by name asynchronously.

methods.name: DeletePartDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Deletes a content part definition by name asynchronously, including removal from types.

methods.name: StoreTypeDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Stores or updates a content type definition asynchronously.

methods.name: StorePartDefinitionAsync
methods.description: Stores or updates a content part definition asynchronously.

methods.name: GetIdentifierAsync
methods.description: Retrieves the identifier of the content definition asynchronously.
